headline: On October 26, 1985: Australia returns Uluru to Aboriginals
captionCards: Uluru is a sacred site and large sandstone monolith
Transfer recognized Indigenous land rights and cultural respect
instagramCaption:
Uluru is returned to its rightful owners. \\[The Australian government officially transferred ownership of Uluru, also known as Ayers Rock, to the local Pitjantjatjara Aboriginals. This large sandstone monolith, located in the southern part of the Northern Territory, is a sacred site. The transfer was a significant step towards recognizing Indigenous land rights. Today, it stands as a symbol of reconciliation and cultural respect. \\What do you think about this act of recognition? \\Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳
